i was ready to pay cash of five hundred rupees but the delivery person refused to accept the payment and left without my order which is very frustrating
the delivery agent asked me to pay through your payment app but my net is not working properly so i could not pay and my order got cancelled which is not fair
long_with_context
can you describe what exactly happened at the time of delivery
the delivery boy came to my home yesterday i gave him seven hundred rupees cash for the order worth six seventy five but he said he cannot accept cash payment
did you try calling the delivery executive or customer care after the incident
yes after the delivery failed i called your helpline and they told me to try a different payment method but no other options were available to me

please tell me what to do if cash on delivery fails at my location

items.context: Did you try paying cash to the delivery agent?
items.text: i attempted cash payment but they refused to accept it

items.context: What payment method did you choose?
items.text: i expected to pay cash but the app asked for prepaid payment only
he came last night and said cash isn't accepted today sadly
the delivery person refused to accept the cash payment and left without my parcel this is very disappointing as i was ready with the full amount
i was informed cash on delivery is available but at the time of delivery they said they only accept payments through the app which is not acceptable to me

items.context: Please explain what issue occurred with your cash on delivery payment
items.text: can you tell me the details of the payment problem you faced today

items.context: What exactly happened during your delivery payment experience?
items.text: i was standing ready with two thousand rupees for the payment but the delivery collector refused cash and asked me to pay online only and then he left without my parcel

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: cod_payment - has a problem with cash on delivery or payment at the door
Language: Indian English, Latin script.
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 18 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 2 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'yes please', 'tomorrow', 'card ending 4321'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 2 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 6 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 4 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 2 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 2 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
